CREATE TABLE "public"."academic_term" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "endDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "moveInFrom" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "moveInTo" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."bill_share" (
  "amountCents" int4 NOT NULL,
  "billId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "paidAt" timestamptz,
  "tenantId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."chat_message_report" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "messageId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "reason" text,
  "reporterId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'open' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "chat_message_report_status_check_13409d73" CHECK ("status" IN ('open', 'dismissed', 'actioned'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."chore" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "everyDays" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "unitId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."chore_task" (
  "assignedToId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "choreId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "doneAt" timestamptz,
  "dueDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "remindedAt" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."email_verification_code" (
  "attempts" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "codeHash" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."guarantor_institution" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "url" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."guarantor_request" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "decidedAt" timestamptz,
  "guarantorEmail" text,
  "guarantorName" text,
  "guarantorPhone" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "institutionId" uuid,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "staffNote" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."identity_verification" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "decidedAt" timestamptz,
  "detail" text,
  "docPath" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "institution" text,
  "method" text NOT NULL,
  "reviewNote" text,
  "reviewedById" uuid,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."lease" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "depositCents" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "endDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "monthlyRentCents" int4 NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "termId" uuid,
  "unitId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "upfrontMonths" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."lease_charge" (
  "amountCents" int4 NOT NULL,
  "dueDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "leaseId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "paidAt" timestamptz,
  "periodEnd" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "periodStart" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "prorated" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."listing" (
  "acceptedRequestId" uuid,
  "availableFrom" timestamptz,
  "availableTo" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "priceCents" int4,
  "sellerId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'open' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "unitId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "wanted" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."listing_request" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "listingId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "requesterId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."match_connection" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "fromId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "toId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."match_profile" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "alcohol" text NOT NULL,
  "bio" text NOT NULL,
  "cleanliness" int4 NOT NULL,
  "cooking" text NOT NULL,
  "dealbreakers" text NOT NULL,
  "guestPolicy" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "noiseTolerance" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sleepSchedule" text NOT NULL,
  "smoking" text NOT NULL,
  "studyHabit" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."shared_bill" (
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dueDate" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "note" text,
  "paidById" uuid NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "totalCents" int4 NOT NULL,
  "unitId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sublease" (
  "approvedById" uuid,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "endDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "listingId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "subtenantId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."unit_media" (
  "caption" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "unitId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "url" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."verified_domain" (
  "domain" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "institution" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."wellbeing_case" (
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "consentToShare" bool NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "escalatedAt" timestamptz,
  "escalatedTo" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "origin" text DEFAULT 'self' NOT NULL,
  "severity" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'open' NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."wellbeing_event" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actor" text NOT NULL,
  "caseId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "detail" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
